risk_if_not_implemented: Without Asymmetric Keys, data in transit and at rest may be exposed through weak, misconfigured or compromised cryptographic protections. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Cryptographic Key Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate cryptographic key management controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of keys.
compensating_control_1.justification: Cryptographic Key Management (CRY-10) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Asymmetric Keys (CRY-10.2) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Configuration Management Program
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of configuration management controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Configuration Management Program (CFG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Asymmetric Keys (CRY-10.2) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
